_clickable: every selector here is a control someone confirmed does NOT mutate — it navigates, filters, expands or dismisses. plan.py cannot check that (nothing in the markup says so), so this list IS the assertion. Adding one is a deliberate act and shows up in the diff. Never list a control that posts, votes, edits or deletes.

crop._comment: the three numbers are FLOORS; `fromAppFrame` derives the real top boundary from the app iframe's own rect at capture time and takes the max. Same host page as the other centred-column apps, so the same conditional rewards banner can move that boundary ~36px. See frame.py's app_frame_bands.

_selectorKindError: 🔴 EVERY SELECTOR IN THIS RECIPE WAS BUILT ON `#pano-controls`, WHICH MATCHES NOTHING AND NEVER DID. `pano-controls` is a custom-element TAG NAME, not an id: the live frame contains exactly ONE element carrying an `id` attribute, `div#root`. This is not sensei's mistake (an anchor taken from a populated screen); it is a selector-KIND error, and it was labelled `live-verified 2026-08-13` while matching zero elements. Re-measured live 2026-08-18 on a genuinely foregrounded window: `document.querySelector('#pano-controls')` -> null in a fully booted frame (hasAppLoading:false, 610 chars of body text, 16 testids, 13 buttons). The old comment also claimed 'this app's controls carry no data-testid' — false: there are 16.

ready._comment:
the Scene textarea, inside the always-mounted panel. 🔴 SCOPE OF THE CLAIM: measured present at TWO points — fresh boot, and after a preset click — which were structurally identical. Both are PRE-GENERATION. The genuinely populated state (a rendered panorama) sits behind the spend path and was NOT measured, so 'survives populated' is a structural INFERENCE (you cannot generate a second panorama without the prompt box), not a measurement. 🔴 NEVER use `#root`: it lives in the static HTML shell (`curl` returns an 814-byte body that is just `
`, 0 testids), so it is present BEFORE the app boots and even in a deadlocked frame — the gate would pass early and hand a spinner to the actions. That is the inverse of sensei's bug and worse. Every `pn-*` testid is JS-rendered post-boot, which is what makes a testid a genuine boot signal here.
